title: Nuclei-seq Protocol
author: Mandy Xu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8b8hsrw
materials: Douncing is done when solution appears milky

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Reagents
steps.instruction: Set up the workspace and chill necessary equipment on ice.

substeps.instruction: Rack 4 falcon tubes (lysis buffer, wash buffer, nuclei, intermediate) and 1 FACS tube on ice.
Chill centrifuges to 4°C.

Clean the hood and fill Styrofoam boxes: one with dry ice (containing a petri dish and razor blade), one slanted with ice for a petri dish, and one with ice for falcon tubes, 1 weighed epp tube, and a douncer with A pestle.
Clean douncer, pestle, and forceps with ethanol; wrap forceps and ethanol again.
Place Pestle B and forceps on a kimwipe beside the ice in the hood.
Prepare Ranin wide bore tips and p1000 pipettes.
Prep 5 epi tubes on a rack: three for checking lysis completion, one for final FACS resuspension (leave on ice), and one for counting.

steps.title: Tissue Preparation and Initial Lysis
steps.instruction: Weigh and chop tissue to initiate nuclei release.

substeps.instruction: Weigh tissue (30-50mg ideal, save the rest).
Cut tissue into 1-2mm3 pieces using a chilled razor on dry ice.
Add enough lysis buffer to cover the tissue and transfer to ice to continue chopping, using a pipette to rinse the blade with the sample's lysis buffer.
Transfer to nuclei tube and allow to lyse for 5 min.

steps.title: Mechanical Nuclei Extraction
steps.instruction: Dounce the sample to release nuclei and refine the suspension.

substeps.instruction: Dounce the supernatant first (1-2 strokes) and transfer to the 4th tube.
Add enough lysis buffer to resuspend the pellet in the douncer, dounce, and transfer to the 4th tube.
Resuspend the 4th tube with a wide bore tip; check completion using residual on the tip and tip of a p20 in SYBR using countess chips.
Transfer the supernatant to the nuclei tube, leaving the pellet behind.
Transfer the pellet back to the douncer and dounce with pestle B (1/3-1/2 of pellet depending on toughness) for 2-4 strokes.
Rinse out the douncer with lysis buffer and transfer to the nuclei tube.
Resuspend nuclei and count again with leftover in p1000 tip; dounce again based on results.

steps.title: Nuclei Washing and Filtration
steps.instruction: Wash the nuclei and filter out aggregates.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 800g for 10 min.
Wash with 2ml of wash buffer.
Spin at 800g for 10 min.
Wash again with 2ml of wash buffer.
Spin for 10 min at 800g and resuspend in 1ml.
Filter with 40um Flowmi cell strainer and transfer to 1.5ml LoBind tube on ice.
Wash again with 2ml of wash buffer.
Spin for 10 min at 800g and resuspend in 1ml.
Filter with 40um Flowmi cell strainer and transfer to 1.5ml LoBind tube on ice.

steps.title: DAPI Staining and FACS Preparation
steps.instruction: Stain nuclei and prepare for sorting.

substeps.instruction: Mix 40ul buffer + 5ul nuclei.
Add DAPI: use 10ul if nuclei > 1 million, or 6-8ul if nuclei < 1 million.
Incubate DAPI for 5 min.
Note nuclei condition, number of strokes, and nuclei size after loading.
Keep the wash and resuspension buffer on ice; do not discard.

steps.title: FACS Sorting
steps.instruction: Sort nuclei using the Influx BRV cell sorter.

substeps.instruction: Use Influx BRV (TMDT, LAB 2-504) for 1-1.5 hours.
Gate for DAPI positive and exclude debris/nuclei aggregates.
Collect nuclei in the Wash and Resuspension Buffer.
Wash the nuclei with the Wash and Resuspension Buffer.

steps.title: Post-FACS Processing
steps.instruction: Recover and prepare sorted nuclei for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 800g for 10 min and remove the supernatant (sheath buffer + wash and resuspension buffer).
Resuspend the pellet in fresh, cold wash and resuspension buffer (calculate volume for a final concentration of approximately 1000 nuclei/ul).
Stain the nuclei with DAPI at the concentration suggested by the manufacturer.
Count the nuclei and proceed directly to 10X 3’ RNA seq.
